title: Thanksgiving in Mammoth Lakes with kids
hook: Thanksgiving in the mountains, 5 hours from LA
who: Families driving up from Los Angeles; kids 3 and up (notes for little ones and teens)

stops.name: Leave Los Angeles
stops.why: About 5 hours to Mammoth; leave early, arrive in daylight
stops.kid_note: Carry chains in winter even if the forecast is clear.

stops.name: Alabama Hills (Mobius Arch Trailhead)
stops.why: Granite arches below the High Sierra, west of Lone Pine
stops.kid_note: There's a porta potty at the Mobius Arch trailhead.
stops.address: Movie Rd off Whitney Portal Rd, Lone Pine, CA
stops.booking_note: From Lone Pine: Whitney Portal Rd 2.5 mi, then right on Movie Rd.

stops.name: Erick Schat's Bakkery
stops.why: Home of the Original Sheepherder Bread (1938); sandwich bar
stops.kid_note: Let each kid pick one pastry for the last leg.

stops.name: Check in: Mammoth Mountain Inn
stops.why: Across from Main Lodge; pool, hot tubs, game room
stops.kid_note: Game room with PlayStation and Xbox; board games at the front desk.
stops.booking_note: Check-in 4 PM. Our pick, not a booking.

stops.name: Mammoth Brewing Company
stops.why: House root beer for the kids, by Main and Minaret
stops.kid_note: Root beer is the all-ages pour.
stops.address: 18 Lake Mary Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546

legs.note: About 213 mi via US-395. The whole LA-to-Mammoth drive is about 5 hours without stops. On Nov 10 Caltrans had one-way traffic control near the SR 190 junction (Inyo County).
About 43 mi. If chain controls are up: at R2, 4WD/AWD with snow tires on all four wheels can skip chains but must carry them.

stops.name: Woolly's Tube Park
stops.why: Snow tubing lanes, open daily Nov 20 to 29 (scheduled)
stops.kid_note: Riders must be 42 inches or taller; one person per tube.
stops.booking_note: Book a session online; onsite tickets from 9:30 AM. Scheduled 'weather and conditions permitting.'

stops.name: Mountain Coaster at Woolly's
stops.why: Same stop, same dates: Woolly's mountain coaster
stops.kid_note: Kids 3+ and 38 in.+ ride with an adult 18+; solo riders 54 in.+
stops.booking_note: Book ahead; every rider signs a digital waiver emailed before the day.

stops.name: Mountainside Bar & Grill (Thanksgiving dinner)
stops.why: Carving stations: turkey, prime rib, salmon, the sides
stops.kid_note: A family-friendly room with kid dishes on the regular menu.
stops.address: Mammoth Mountain Inn, 10400 Minaret Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA
stops.booking_note: Seatings 2:30, 5:00 and 7:30 PM. Book now. A hot dinner to go for 2-4 is also offered.

legs.note: Free Red Line shuttle from The Village every 20 minutes; Woolly's is about halfway between The Village and Main Lodge.
Back for a rest before dinner.

alternative.name: The Lakefront Restaurant (Tamarack Lodge)
alternative.text: Quieter, lakeside option: a 4-course prix fixe. 3:00 PM seating $105 adult, $55 child; 5:00 and 7:30 PM $125 adult, $65 child (before tax, plus a $40 corkage fee per bottle). Public booking opened Nov 5. No kids' menu on regular nights.

stops.name: The Stove
stops.why: Breakfast classics in Old Mammoth for 40+ years
stops.address: 644 Old Mammoth Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA

stops.name: Panorama Gondola to the summit
stops.why: Up to 11,053 ft for the summit sign and the views
stops.kid_note: Up to two kids 12 and under ride free with each paying adult.
stops.address: Main Lodge, 10001 Minaret Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA
stops.booking_note: Daily from Nov 13, weather permitting; check Lift & Trail Status for holds. The Eleven53 Interpretive Center is included.

stops.name: Sunset Snowshoe Tour, Tamarack
stops.why: A guided 1.5-hour walk to the Panorama Dome lookout
stops.kid_note: Moderate terrain. No minimum age is listed, so ask when you book.
stops.address: 163 Twin Lakes Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA
stops.booking_note: Departs 3:15 or 3:30 PM; snowshoes included. Needs snow: Tamarack was closed on Nov 9.

stops.name: Toomey's
stops.why: Dinner in The Village before the lights go on

stops.name: Holiday Tree Lighting in The Village
stops.why: Santa and Woolly light the tree at 8; it's free
stops.kid_note: Free photos with Santa and Woolly at 8:15 PM at Mammoth Sports.
stops.booking_note: DJ from 6 PM, live music at 7.

days.title: Maybe a lesson, then biscuits and bowling

stops.name: First ski lesson (only if beginner terrain is open)
stops.why: Only if the Mountain Report shows beginner terrain
stops.kid_note: Kids must be 3+ and potty-trained; 4 and under ski free with a ticket.
stops.address: Main Lodge, 10001 Minaret Rd, Mammoth Lakes, CA
stops.booking_note: No beginner terrain or lessons were available on Nov 9. Check the report before you book.

stops.name: Bird and the Biscuit
stops.why: Scratch biscuits, fried chicken and banana pudding
stops.kid_note: It's closed Wednesdays, so it lands on Saturday.
stops.address: 26 Old Mammoth Rd, Unit L1, Mammoth Lakes, CA 93546

stops.name: Pool and hot tubs at the inn
stops.why: Heated outdoor pool and hot tubs, open 8 AM to 10 PM
stops.kid_note: First-floor game room if it's too cold to swim.

stops.name: Mammoth Rock 'n' Bowl
stops.why: Bowling and dinner, with views of the Sherwins

days.title: Home, with one stop that matters

stops.name: Leave Mammoth Lakes
stops.why: South on US-395; check road conditions first

stops.name: Manzanar National Historic Site
stops.why: Where 11,000+ Japanese Americans were incarcerated in WWII
stops.kid_note: Big history for older kids: Block 14's rebuilt barracks make it real.
stops.booking_note: Visitor center Fri to Mon, 9 to 4:30 (closed Tue to Thu). Grounds and driving tour sunrise to sunset.

stops.name: Drive home to Los Angeles
stops.why: About 220 mi south on US-395

stays.name: Mammoth Mountain Inn
stays.why: Across from Main Lodge, steps from ski school and the gondola; pool, hot tubs, game room, and Thanksgiving dinner upstairs.

stays.name: The Village Lodge
stays.why: Studios to 3-bedroom condos with full kitchens (cook your own turkey), a heated pool and a game room, steps from the tree lighting. No cribs.

stays.name: The Westin Monache
stays.why: Heated pool and hot tubs, the Westin Family Kids Club, suites with fireplaces, next to The Village.

stays.name: Tamarack Lodge cabins
stays.why: Cabins with kitchens on Twin Lakes, the cross-country and snowshoe center at the door. Cell service is spotty.

heads_ups.text: Ski lessons aren't a given: on Nov 9, 3 of 181 trails were open and there was no beginner terrain.
The Village Gondola was closed on Nov 9, and Mammoth's lodging page says it typically runs mid-December to mid-April.
Tioga Pass (Hwy 120) into Yosemite was still open Nov 6, but the Park Service says it closes with snow, usually in November, until late May or June.
Devils Postpile's season ended Oct 30, and the Lakes Basin road and Hwy 203 past Main Lodge are closed for winter.
Manzanar's visitor center is closed Tuesday to Thursday, which is why it's on Sunday's drive home, not Wednesday's.
June Mountain, Mammoth's family-friendly sister resort, doesn't open until Dec 19, 2026.

Thanksgiving dinners run on fixed seatings; The Lakefront opened bookings to the public on Nov 5. Apricity, the Westin's new restaurant, is on Mammoth's Thanksgiving list but still listed as coming soon, so we left it out.
